name: @undefineds.co/xpod-desktop
description: Xpod desktop tray shell: window lifecycle, system tray and external browser hand-off for the local settings dashboard.

scripts.start: bun run build && dotenv -e ../.env.local -o -- env XPOD_ENV_FILE=../.env.local electron dist/main.js
scripts.smoke: bun run build && dotenv -e ../.env.local -o -- env XPOD_ENV_FILE=../.env.local XPOD_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1 electron dist/main.js
scripts.build:runtime: cd .. && bun run build && bun scripts/build-bun-single.js --output=desktop/runtime/xpod
scripts.dist: bun run build:runtime && bun run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test test/*.test.ts
